column7: Typo – pikavidhustava is absolutely NOT a compound (samāsa). It is a purely visual artifact of scriptio continua. It mathematically resolves into three discrete, fully inflected syntactic entities: LB pika (m.voc.sg.) -> "O cuckoo!" LB vidhuḥ (m.nom.sg.) -> "the moon" (the sovereign nominative subject). LB tava (pron.gen.sg.) -> "your" (modifying the darkness). LB Furthermore, the digitizer erroneously fused the anusvāra (ṃ) into a dental nasal (n) via an unspaced parasavarṇa sandhi artifact (Pāṇini 8.4.58 anusvārasya yayi parasavarṇaḥ), collapsing samaṃ tamas into samantamas, and subsequently fusing the entire string into the monolithic samantamastvamapi. This OCR/typesetting corruption annihilated the visibility of the accusative object tamaḥ (darkness).
